jd_full:
About Us
Diamour Jewellers is a Hatton Garden-based jewellery business specialising in diamond engagement rings, wedding bands, bespoke jewellery and fine diamond collections.
We are seeking a motivated, analytical and commercially focused Business Analyst to join our growing team. The successful candidate will be responsible for analysing business operations, evaluating performance, identifying opportunities for improvement and developing strategies to enhance operational efficiency and support business growth.
Key Responsibilities
• Analyse existing business processes, including jewellery sales, inventory management, procurement, customer service and bespoke order fulfilment.
• Evaluate operational performance and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, productivity and profitability.
• Conduct market research and analyse customer purchasing trends, competitor activities and developments within the jewellery sector.
• Review online and showroom sales performance and recommend improvements to business processes and customer experience.
• Assess existing stock management, order processing and customer relationship management systems to identify operational improvements.
• Gather and document business requirements for enhancements to internal systems, digital platforms and operational workflows.
• Prepare business cases, feasibility studies and cost-benefit analyses for proposed business improvements and expansion initiatives.
• Develop key performance indicators (KPIs), analyse business data and prepare performance reports for senior management.
• Work closely with management, employees, suppliers and external service providers to identify business requirements and implement agreed improvements.
• Evaluate supplier and procurement processes and recommend improvements to purchasing efficiency and stock availability.
• Monitor the implementation of business improvements, assess outcomes against agreed objectives and recommend further action.
• Provide analytical insights and strategic recommendations to support business planning and long-term commercial development.
Qualifications and Experience
• Bachelor's degree or higher qualification in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Economics or a related discipline.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills.
• Ability to analyse business data, evaluate processes and develop practical recommendations.
• Good understanding of business operations, commercial performance and process improvement.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Office and business reporting tools.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present findings clearly to management.
• Ability to prepare professional reports, business cases and performance assessments.
• Previous experience in business analysis, financial analysis, operations or a commercial environment is desirable.
• Knowledge of retail operations, e-commerce, inventory management or the luxury jewellery sector would be advantageous.
What We Offer
• Competitive annual salary of £35,100.
• Full-time permanent position.
• Opportunity to contribute to the development and growth of the business.
• Supportive and professional working environment.
• Career development opportunities.
• Involvement in business improvement and strategic development projects.
How to Apply
Interested candidates should submit an updated CV and a covering letter outlining their relevant qualifications, skills, and experience to careers@diamourjewellers.co.uk.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent
Pay: £35,100.00 per year

Work Location: In person

Arup's Finance Strategic Transformation Programme is a major global initiative implementing Oracle Fusion ERP and EPM, creating a modern cloud-based finance platform to simplify processes, strengthen data and reporting and improve decision-making.

• Experience in finance reporting, analytics or performance-management transformation.
• Strong knowledge of operational, management, statutory and regulatory finance reporting.

• Ability to translate business questions into clear reporting, KPI, data and reconciliation requirements.

About Absolute Strategy Research
Absolute Strategy Research (ASR) is an independent investment research firm providing macroeconomic and investment strategy research to institutional investors worldwide.
Our clients include leading asset managers, pension funds, insurers, wealth managers and hedge funds.
We are looking for an ambitious and commercially minded graduate to join our team, gaining experience across business development, marketing, commercial operations and wider business management.

The Opportunity
Broad, hands-on experience within an established financial services business, working closely with experienced colleagues and senior management. The role offers exposure to marketing and sales, financial reporting, business planning and day-to-day operations.

Key Responsibilities
• Research prospective clients, markets and new business opportunities.
• Support business development activities, client communications and follow-up.
• Assist with preparing presentations, proposals, reports and meeting materials.

• Support the planning and delivery of marketing campaigns and communications.
• Assist with promoting, publishing and distributing research, events and other business initiatives.
• Help maintain website content, marketing materials and digital channels.
• Maintain accurate client and business information across internal systems.
• Support commercial reporting, performance tracking and business analysis.
• Assist with financial reporting, budgeting and wider business planning activities.
• Support day-to-day business operations, administrative processes and internal projects.
• Assist with client onboarding, supplier relationships, contracts and compliance-related activities.
• Identify opportunities to improve internal processes, reporting and operational efficiency.
• Contribute to wider business initiatives and projects, working with colleagues across different teams.

Development & Progression
The role provides a foundation in marketing, commercial operations and institutional business development, with the potential to develop towards a more client-facing sales position.

About you
Essential:
• A degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent experience.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Confidence working with data, spreadsheets and digital tools.
• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• A proactive approach, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
• An interest in financial markets, investment research and the institutional investment industry.
• A willingness to learn, take ownership and contribute to a collaborative team.
Desirable:
• Experience through internships, placements or projects involving marketing, sales, research or business development.
• Familiarity with CRM, data management and marketing platforms.
• An aptitude for relationship-building and client-facing communication.

Eligibility to Work in the UK

Pay: £32,000-£37,000 per year

jd_full:
AUTO HUB & TRADING LTD is seeking a skilled and analytical Business Analyst to support the company's business operations, strategic planning and commercial development within the motor vehicle sales and trading sector.

The successful candidate will be responsible for analysing business performance, identifying operational improvements, evaluating market trends and developing data-driven recommendations to improve efficiency, profitability and business growth. The role will involve working closely with management and operational teams to assess business requirements, monitor sales performance, improve internal processes and support informed commercial decision-making.

Key Duties and Responsibilities
• Analyse the company's business operations, sales performance and financial data to identify trends, performance gaps and opportunities for improvement.
• Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify developments in the used vehicle market, customer demand, pricing trends and business opportunities.
• Evaluate vehicle purchasing, stock management and sales processes to identify inefficiencies and recommend improvements.
• Prepare detailed business reports, performance dashboards and analytical summaries to support management decision-making and strategic planning.
• Analyse sales figures, profit margins, vehicle turnover rates and operational costs to assess business performance and recommend measures to improve profitability.
• Gather and assess business requirements from management and relevant departments, translating them into practical recommendations and improvement plans.
• Review existing business procedures and develop strategies to improve operational efficiency, resource utilisation and workflow management.
• Monitor customer purchasing patterns, market demand and sales trends to support effective vehicle stock planning and commercial strategies.
• Work with management to develop business forecasts, performance targets and operational plans based on market research and historical business data.
• Identify potential business risks and operational challenges, providing evidence-based recommendations to minimise their impact.
• Support the implementation of new business processes, reporting systems and operational improvements, monitoring their effectiveness.
• Liaise with internal teams and external stakeholders to collect relevant business information and ensure that operational objectives are achieved.
• Present analytical findings and recommendations to senior management, providing clear explanations of business performance and proposed improvements.

Skills and Experience Required
• Strong analytical, numerical and problem-solving skills.
• Experience in business analysis, market research and performance evaluation.
• Ability to analyse complex business information and prepare detailed reports.
• Knowledge of sales performance analysis, stock management and commercial operations.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, reporting tools and business analysis software.
• Strong communication, organisational and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to identify business improvement opportunities and develop practical solutions.
• Experience in the automotive or vehicle trading industry would be advantageous.

Reporting Structure
The Business Analyst will report directly to the company's senior management and work collaboratively with relevant operational and commercial teams to support business planning, performance monitoring and organisational development.

Pay: £45,000.00-£50,000.00 per year
Benefits: On-site parking
Work Location: In person

Circa £32,831 (depending on skills and experience). Permanent / initial 12-month FTC. Full time, 37 hours, flexible working. Peterborough, Huntingdon or Lincoln.
We're looking for two PMO Analysts to join Anglian Water's Performance team, supporting the planning, governance and delivery controls that help programmes and portfolios achieve their objectives. One position will be offered as a permanent role, the other as an initial 12-month fixed-term contract.
You'll maintain plans, financial information, risks, actions, issues, changes and dependencies while turning complex delivery data into clear reports and dashboards for management teams and programme boards.
What you could be doing
• Maintain portfolio and programme plans, financial information, benefits tracking, dependencies and delivery records
• Manage risks, actions, issues and change registers for governance
• PMO administration: governance meeting papers, agendas, minutes, decisions and action tracking
• Collate, analyse and evaluate delivery data to produce clear reports and management dashboards
• Bring project reports together into programme and portfolio-level information for leadership and board review
• Quality assure plans, workbooks, registers and highlight reports against standards and templates
• Support programme and project health checks
• Provide first-line guidance and support on PMO processes, documents and tools
• Maintain secure SharePoint sites and document libraries
• Support strategic prioritisation through planning, coordination and facilitation
• Analyse resource and delivery plans; tactical resource management
• Improve PMO tools, templates, reporting and ways of working
• Support the specification and testing of Power BI dashboards
What we're looking for
• A project management qualification or practical experience supporting projects, programmes or portfolios
• Understanding of delivery controls across Waterfall, Agile or hybrid environments
• Experience collating, analysing and presenting complex data for reporting and decision-making
• Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, excellent attention to detail
• Understanding of risk management processes and delivery governance
• Strong stakeholder management and communication
• Confidence using Microsoft Office, Microsoft Project and SharePoint
• Proactive ownership; practical, improvement-focused approach
• Experience managing complex and moving data sets
• Facilitation skills
Desirable
• Monday.com; experience in a PMO; coaching others on project controls; writing and managing risks and issues; project financial planning, forecasting and SAP; optimising resource plans; Power BI dashboard specification or testing
Benefits: 25 days' leave plus bank holidays, flexible working, private healthcare, double-matched pension up to 7%, life assurance 8x salary, annual bonus.
Closing date: 29 November 2026. Apply with an up-to-date CV; a cover letter is recommended. Offers subject to references, driving licence check, DBS and right to work checks.

Marketing & Commercial Analyst

For more than 65 years, Ifor Williams Trailers has set the standard for durability, performance and innovation in trailer manufacturing. We are looking for an analytical and commercially minded Marketing & Commercial Analyst to join our marketing team, supporting the growth of our online and social media presence and helping to promote sales of our trailers.

Paid media
• Plan, build, launch and optimise paid campaigns across social and search platforms.

• Use AI tools to support campaign planning and set-up.
• Test audiences, messages and formats.
• Support the promotion of our dealer network.
Performance and reporting

jd_full:
Interim Planning Analyst - Jimmy Choo, London

Role Purpose
The Planning Analyst will support the Global Planning team across business-as-usual and continuous improvement activities, providing reporting, analysis and operational support across planning, forecasting, replenishment and S&OP processes. Experience developing, configuring or supporting AI agents, Microsoft Copilot or other generative AI technologies is desirable.

Planning & Business Support
• Support Planning, Forecasting, Replenishment and S&OP processes with data, reporting and analysis.
• Produce regular KPI reporting and performance analysis.
• Conduct ad hoc analysis to identify risks, opportunities and trends.
• Assist in preparing planning and S&OP materials and presentations.
• Gather, consolidate and validate information from multiple stakeholders and systems.

Reporting & Data Management
• Extract and prepare data from business systems and databases.
• Maintain and update reports, dashboards and planning tools.
• Develop reporting using Excel, Power Query, Power Pivot and Power BI.
• Ensure data accuracy and support reporting and process improvements.

Operational & Administrative Support
• Support day-to-day planning administration, recurring reports, action tracking and documentation.
• Support data validation and reconciliation.

Continuous Improvement & Project Support
• Support business improvement initiatives across Planning.
• Contribute to process reviews, documentation and process mapping.
• Assist with testing, data validation and user support during system or process changes.
• Support business projects and change initiatives alongside BAU.

Skills & Experience
• Experience within a retail, FMCG or consumer products environment.
• Understanding of Planning, Forecasting and S&OP processes.

Sales Analyst - Adams Aviation Supply Company Ltd, Crawley
Adams Aviation is a distributor of aviation parts and equipment (general, commercial and business aviation, helicopters and military) with a headset and ELT repair centre. As Sales Analyst you will turn sales data into clear, actionable insight, working with the General Manager, Sales, Business Development, Purchasing and Finance. More than a reporting role: interpret the data, challenge performance and communicate findings with confidence.

Key responsibilities
1. Sales reporting and performance
• Produce daily, weekly and monthly sales reports, dashboards and KPIs.
• Track revenue, gross profit and margin against budget by customer, product category, manufacturer, territory and salesperson.

2. Customers and business development
• Analyse purchasing patterns, retention and account development; flag inactive and lapsed accounts.
• Provide customer and market information and assess campaigns.
3. Pricing and profitability
• Work with Sales, Purchasing and Finance on pricing; profitability analysis for key customers.
4. Stock and product performance
• Analyse demand and stock movement; identify slow-moving, obsolete and surplus stock and fast-moving lines.
5. Forecasting and planning
• Help prepare sales forecasts, budgets and commercial plans; monitor progress against targets.
6. Systems and data quality
• Use ERP and BI systems (Merlin and Phocas) and Excel-based reports and models; fix data issues; automate recurring reports.

Essential skills
• Experience in a Sales, Commercial, Business Partner or similar data-focused role.
• Advanced Excel analysis; strong numerical and analytical skills.
• Understanding of revenue, gross profit, margins and commercial KPIs.
• Present complex information clearly; well organised; commercially aware; collaborative; adaptable.

Desirable skills
• ERP and BI platforms (Phocas, Merlin, Power BI or similar).
• Background in distribution, wholesale or retail.
• Inventory management and supply chain understanding.
• Customer profitability, pricing and margin management.

Pay: £35,000 - £50,000 per year. Benefits: pension, sick pay, free parking. Work location: in person.

Business Analyst - DXC Technology, Insurance Software & Business Process Services (ISB), London
DXC Technology is a global technology services company; its Insurance Software & BPS business supports insurers across life, wealth, health, P&C and reinsurance, and is a key partner to the London Market.

The Opportunity
We're looking for an experienced Business Analyst to join our Insurance Software & BPS transformation environment, helping turn customer, market and business needs into clear, prioritised and actionable requirements. This is a hands-on BA role across the change lifecycle, from understanding business processes and gathering requirements to defining acceptance criteria, supporting delivery and validating solutions before cutover. What You'll Be Doing

• Work across transformation, architecture, change and delivery teams to resolve ambiguity.
• Assess the impact of proposed changes and highlight material impacts before commitments are made.
• Support solution validation against agreed business need and acceptance criteria before cutover.
• Maintain high standards of BA documentation.

What We're Looking For
• Strong Business Analysis experience gained within complex transformation or change programmes.
• Banking, insurance or London Market experience (highly desirable).
• Strong process analysis and requirements-management experience.
• Experience eliciting, analysing, documenting and prioritising business requirements.
• Experience maintaining requirements traceability.
• Ability to create clear, concise and testable requirements.
• Experience defining measurable outcomes and robust acceptance criteria.
• Experience supporting requirements sign-off and solution validation.

Operational Data Analyst
Location: Normanton. Department: Operations. Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience.
About the role
Generator Power is looking for an analytical and organised Operational Data Analyst to join the Operations team at Normanton. You will own the daily and weekly operational reporting cycle, producing accurate and timely analysis across breakdowns, faults, deployments, permits, fuel usage and telemetry. Working closely with the Operational Analytics Manager and operational teams, you will maintain reliable datasets, identify trends and exceptions, and turn complex information into clear reports.
Key responsibilities
• Produce and distribute daily breakdown and fault analysis across Telecoms, Utilities and General Operations.
• Prepare the daily Telecoms fault report for the 9:00am operational call (outstanding faults, ageing cases, repeat failures).
• Maintain operational datasets covering jobs, deployments, services, refuels, invoices and asset status.
• Check and validate information from operational systems, investigating missing or conflicting data.
• Produce weekly customer reporting packs (reliability, fuel usage, site access efficiencies).
• Monitor KPIs: fault volumes, response times, SLA performance, asset utilisation, deployment activity, fuel status, telemetry availability.
• Produce Excel reports, charts and commentary for depot teams, managers, directors and customers.
• Develop and improve reporting processes using Excel, Power Query, SQL, Power BI and Microsoft 365 tools.
• Maintain reporting records (data sources, calculation methods, procedures).
• Support monthly operational reviews, quarterly customer reviews, service-credit calculations and ad-hoc analysis.
Essential
• Strong working knowledge of Excel (formulas, lookups, PivotTables, charts, conditional formatting).
• Good numerical ability and confidence checking and explaining data.
• Strong written and verbal communication.
• Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach; able to manage multiple priorities.
• Practical experience analysing, checking or presenting data (employment, university projects, placements or internships).
• Ability to identify data-quality issues and investigate discrepancies.
• Confidence working independently while knowing when to escalate.
Desirable
• Power Query, Power BI, SQL or Power Automate.
• A degree in Data Analysis, Business, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Information Systems, Engineering or another numerate subject.
• Experience in operational, service, logistics, engineering, utilities, telecoms, fleet, plant hire or asset-based environments.
• Exposure to KPI, SLA, fault, permit, fuel, telemetry or asset-utilisation reporting.
• Experience improving reporting processes or reducing manual data handling.

jd_summary: Advise directors on operational and commercial problems across lettings, property management, sourcing and renovation. Analyse pricing, occupancy, yields and voids; review processes; build business cases and financial appraisals; set up KPIs and management reports; benchmark competitors. Needs a bachelor's in management/business (master's desirable), strong Excel, clear presentation skills. Apply by emailing CV + short cover letter to info@decitihomesltd.co.uk. In person, London.
jd_full:
You will advise the directors on how to solve operational and commercial problems, create value, grow the business and improve performance across our lettings, management, sourcing and renovation services. You will use data and business analysis to give objective, evidence-based recommendations and to help the team build any new skills or processes we need.

Key responsibilities:
• Analyse pricing, occupancy, rental yield, void periods and market data across our managed and sourced properties, and report on what the data shows.
• Review how our lettings, property management, sourcing and renovation processes work, find inefficiencies and risks, and recommend practical improvements.
• Prepare business cases and financial appraisals for new markets, service lines and property investment opportunities, and present options to the directors.
• Identify and assess operational, financial and compliance risks, and recommend controls.
• Set up and track key performance indicators for each service, and produce regular management reports.
• Benchmark our services and fees against competitors and market trends.
• Work with the team to implement agreed changes and support them in developing the skills and processes needed to deliver them.

Requirements:
A bachelor's degree or above in management, business or a related subject. A master's degree in management is desirable.
Strong analytical skills and good competence with Excel or similar tools for data analysis and reporting.
Clear written and spoken communication, and the ability to present findings and recommendations to senior colleagues.
Interest in the UK residential property sector, including lettings, property management or investment.
Good organisation and the ability to work independently and manage multiple projects.

Desirable:
Experience in property, real estate, consultancy or a similar commercial analysis role.
Familiarity with property or CRM software and data visualisation tools.

Right to work:
Applicants must have the right to work in the UK. Deciti Homes holds a sponsor licence and may be able to sponsor a suitable candidate for a Skilled Worker visa, subject to eligibility.

How to apply: send your CV and a short cover letter to info@decitihomesltd.co.uk.
Job types: Full-time, Permanent. Pay: £35,100–£38,000 per year. Work location: in person (London).

jd_summary: Conflict checks and client inception for a national law firm: review and resolve conflict search results, information barriers, compliance queries, workflow and controls project work. Risk/compliance experience preferred but not essential.
jd_full:
Purpose of the role: join the Conflicts team at Addleshaw Goddard to help the firm meet its regulatory obligations by managing and mitigating risk: conflict checks, client inception work, managing client terms and matter specifications, and risk analysis on the firm's publications.

The team sits in the Office of the General Counsel, across Leeds, Manchester, Edinburgh, Glasgow and Dubai.

Responsibilities:
• Review, filter and resolve conflict search results, including legal and commercial analysis of potential conflicts and confidentiality issues; escalate key issues.
• Liaise with PAs, fee earners, partners and the wider conflicts team.
• Manage the team inbox: information barriers, extended reports, ad hoc tasks and compliance queries under supervision.
• Support project work, including workflow development and monitoring of systems and controls.

Knowledge and experience:
• Risk and compliance experience in a law firm, accountancy or financial services is preferred but not essential.
• Strong research and critical analysis; sound judgement.
• Ability to work at pace and prioritise.
• Stakeholder relationship building.
• Basic knowledge of the Money Laundering Regulations 2019, Proceeds of Crime Act 2002, UN/UK/US sanctions and the SRA Code of Conduct 2019.
• Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel); Intapp desirable.

Permanent, full time. Locations: Edinburgh, Glasgow, Leeds, Manchester. Salary: competitive.

jd_full:
Client Research Centre Analyst
Location: London · Permanent · Hybrid (Tuesday to Thursday in the office)

Who we are: Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment firms, established in 1975, known for integrity, innovation and low-cost investing.

What you'll do:
• Conduct research and analysis on investment, financial planning and practice management topics.
• Produce client-facing content, including presentations, articles and white papers.
• Deliver internal training and present research findings and recommendations to clients.
• Monitor industry thought leadership, regulatory developments and internal policies.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with key internal stakeholders.

What you bring:
• Proven experience in an analytical role within asset management, financial services or a related field.
• Strong research, analytical and data interpretation skills, including primary research.
• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills for data analysis and manipulation.
• Good knowledge of investments, wealth management, financial markets or financial planning.
• Degree-qualified or equivalent, with strong report writing and presentation skills; CFA study is desirable.

Recruited by Robert Walters (Resource Solutions Limited) on behalf of the client through its Outsourcing service line. Successful applicants are contacted directly by a recruiter.
